changes.change: Use iterator zip with one-element skip to compare adjacent sorted broker IDs without indexing.
changes.semantics: For a sorted slice of n broker IDs, both iterators compare exactly pairs (0,1) through (n-2,n-1); zero/one-element cases yield no duplicate. Existing negative-ID predicate and sort remain unchanged. No allocation or error-policy change.

changes.change: Use saturating_add directly for cumulative response-body bytes.
changes.semantics: For unsigned usize operands, checked_add(y).unwrap_or(usize::MAX) and saturating_add(y) yield the same min(x+y,usize::MAX). The existing greater-than16MiB fail-closed check and exhausted state are unchanged.

limitations: This addresses three exact remote strict-lint diagnostics only. It does not establish that subsequent Clippy/test targets are clean.
No CI/local passing gate is claimed. New actual Git source pin and requalification are required before the corrected source is used.
Other remote sticky/conformance/runtime failures remain independently assigned.
